## About Me

Hello, I am an Assistant Professor of Economics at Hope College.

I am a microeconomic theorist specializing in algorithmic market design.

My [working papers](research.qmd) are on the Research page.
This semester I teach [ECON 212: Principles of Microeconomics](econ212/index.qmd) and [ECON 312: Intermediate Microeconomics](econ312/index.qmd).
